description: Internal part of TmSigningFormRunner (Signing redesign phase 3): the permanent field list of the wizard panel — one row per step with the type icon, the localized label, the page and the Done / Required / Optional status chip. A host places TmSigningFormRunner, never this component: the runner owns the step plan, the selection state and the single-panel invariant.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve the localized field labels.

parameters.name: CurrentIndex
parameters.description: Index of the step the runner currently presents; it renders aria-current="step".

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when a field's translation is missing.

parameters.name: IsStepFilled
parameters.description: The runner's completeness predicate for a step (every field of the step has a value) — the "Done" status and the check icon read from it.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised with the clicked step index; the runner selects and focuses that step.

parameters.name: Steps
parameters.description: The runner's planned steps, in field order (already submitter-filtered).
